# SnackbarSeverity

`Flare.Abstractions.SnackbarSeverity`

Severity of a snackbar notification, controlling its accent color and icon.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Normal` | `0` | Neutral notification with no severity accent. |
| `Info` | `1` | Informational notification. |
| `Success` | `2` | Success notification. |
| `Warning` | `3` | Warning notification. |
| `Error` | `4` | Error notification. |
